notes: Official signed GNU Guix 1.5.0 binary closure, release channel commit 230aa373f315f247852ee07dff34146e9b480aec, fixed single-Guix manifest/profile, signed fixture-and-bash closure import, and pure environment execution. Creating arbitrary new manifest profiles or bootstrapping Guix is not qualified; broader dependencies are not bundled.
Method is binary: the official upstream store closure is imported; the package manager itself is not claimed source-built.
Only an isolated local store and private daemon are used. Offline checks fail if user namespaces are denied.
